cards.text: Friend, the kingdom just split: Israel made Jeroboam son of Nebat king (1 Kings 12:2, 19-20), and Rehoboam, Solomon's son, rules Judah (1 Kings 11:43; 12:17). Jeroboam builds up Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, moves in, then heads out and builds Penuel too. Most of us move into a new place and live out of boxes for a MONTH, and this man is already out building the next city.

cards.question: New king, new cities. But Jeroboam has a worry he only says in his heart. What does he think might happen to his kingdom?

answers.text: It might go back to the house of David
It might be taken over by Egypt
It might be split among his sons

cards.text: Jeroboam plays out the whole worst case in his heart, the way I did in the junk drawer I spent years in, wondering if every rattle meant the trash. The house of the LORD is in Jerusalem, and that's where the people go up to offer sacrifices.

cards.question: Jeroboam says if the people go up to sacrifice in Jerusalem, their ___ will return to Rehoboam king of Judah.
True or false: Jeroboam thinks the people might kill him and go back to Rehoboam.

cards.text: So after seeking advice, the king comes up with a fix, and he makes two of something. Friend, every time I fix a problem by doubling it, I end up with TWO problems and a very smoky oven.

cards.question: What does Jeroboam make after seeking advice?

cards.text: Then Jeroboam tells the people, “Going up to Jerusalem is too much for you.” Friend, you tell ME I can skip the long drive and stay home, and you will NOT have to tell me twice.

cards.question: What does Jeroboam tell the people the golden calves are?

answers.text: The gods who brought them out of Egypt
Signs that the LORD chose Jeroboam
Guards to keep the land of Israel safe

cards.question: Jeroboam sets one golden calf up in Bethel and the other in ___.

cards.text: The Bible puts it plainly: “this thing became a sin”. The people walk as far as Dan to worship before one of the calves, and friend, that's a whole lot of walking to end up in the wrong place.
Jeroboam isn't done. He builds shrines on the high places, and now he's got job openings, friend, because shrines need priests.

cards.question: Who does Jeroboam appoint as priests for his shrines?

answers.text: People from every class who aren't Levites
Only Levites who came up from Judah
Only elders who once served Solomon

cards.text: Next up, a feast, and you KNOW I perk up at the word feast. Jeroboam ordains one on the fifteenth day of the eighth month.

cards.question: True or false: Jeroboam's feast is like the feast that was in Judah.
At Jeroboam's new feast, who offers sacrifices on the altar?
True or false: The month of Jeroboam's feast is a month God chose.

cards.text: So there he is in Bethel, offering sacrifices and burning incense at a feast he ordained for the Israelites, in a month he picked all by himself. Hang on, friend, because this story is FAR from over.
